records.reported_backend_detail: TL-M: hand-written double buffer. TWO shared stages per operand (As0/Bs0, As1/Bs1); K loop unrolled by 2 so parity is static. Per half-iteration: T.ptx_wait_group(0) + T.sync_threads() to consume the tile that landed, then T.async_copy(tile g+1)->other stage + T.ptx_commit_group() to ISSUE the next load, then T.gemm on the current stage while that cp.async is in flight. 1 barrier and 1 cp.async group per K tile. T.Pipelined does not appear; the prologue issues tile 0 and the tail prefetch is clamped to the last tile. Chunk flush Cchunk->Cacc every kc=2048.
